sources.title: MindSearch: A Multi-Agent AI Framework Processing 300 ... - MarkTechPost
sources.snippet: Researchers from the University of Science and Technology of China and the Shanghai AI Laboratory have introduced MindSearch, a novel framework designed to mimic human cognitive processes in web information-seeking and integration. MindSearch is a multi-agent framework consisting of a WebPlanner and multiple WebSearchers.
